parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Jackson experienced a power failure and is down from Friday Mar 26 through Tuesday Mar 30, with the line restarting the following working day. The supply-chain control tower moved 9 production orders, with 6 rescheduled at the same plant and 3 transferred to other plants because no same-plant slot was free. It also notified 36 dealers once each for 79 customer orders and assigned 17 loaners.
parsed.decision_reason: The system acted because this was a real plant_outage incident with ids and dates resolved against the data, a rehearsal on the digital twin passing with zero failures, and the live baseline matching before the first write as required by the incident handling rules.
